expected.canonical_headline: Teen airlifted after e-bike and vehicle crash on U.S. Highway 1 in Jensen Beach

selected_headlines: Martin County sheriff weighs illegal e-bike seizures, possible charges for parents
source_headlines: Teen thrown 50 feet in Jensen Beach e-bike crash, sheriff warns parents of crackdown - WPEC
novel_facts: The rider is a 14-year-old Port St. Lucie boy who suffered catastrophic injuries and is now in stable condition.
The sheriff said the teen was crossing U.S. 1 when a northbound vehicle with a green light struck him.
Investigators determined the teen's 3,300-watt bike was not street-legal, according to the sheriff.
The sheriff warned that deputies are considering bike seizures and possible criminal charges against parents who knowingly permit illegal riding.
